messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-serving, symptom=heartbeat-missing, region=az3 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: PD alert id PD-88321 - page triggered (high priority). Escalation policy: regional-sre -> oncall.

maria (oncall): acked. I'm on it, joining video. Picking up triage.

ben (sre): quick note — telemetry shows a sharp uptick in kvcache evictions + controller thrash in az3 starting ~2m ago. Could be node oom/eviction or a networking flap.

sam (infra): I'm seeing a flurry of pod restarts on the model-shard pool in az3. nodename node-az3-12 shows repeated kubelet restarts in the logs.

maria (oncall): customer-impact? any spikes in 5xx or latencies?

ben (sre): 5xx rate up from 0.2% -> 1.8% for requests served from az3. Global rate ~0.6%. Affected models: gpt-small/latency-optimized primarily.

jordan (runtime): Suggest immediate traffic shaping: divert 30% of az3 request traffic to az1, enable fallback to gpt-small-compat for canary users. Lower-risk than full failover.

maria (oncall): agree. Ben, can you run the divert? Sam, can you confirm capacity in az1?

ben (sre): running divert now.

```bash
# divert 30% of az3 -> az1
curl -X POST "https://internal-router/api/v1/divert" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_ROUTER_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"from":"az3","to":"az1","percent":30,"reason":"heartbeat-miss-eviction-spike"}'
```

ops-bot: diversion job queued: job-id=divert-7632105555-01. Estimated effect within 45s.

sam (infra): az1 has spare reserved capacity: +120 GPU slots available, can absorb diverted load for short window.

natalie (cs): flagging CS — we should prepare the short blurb in case customers ask about degraded perf. Low-severity so far but some tail latency for a subset.

maria (oncall): drafting customer note. Will post to status page if we see >2% global 5xx or prolonged >10m.

ben (sre): divert appears active. Metrics: az3 traffic down ~28%, error rate in az3 falling, global 5xx -> 0.9%. Good sign.

jordan (runtime): meanwhile I'm enabling the lower-memory model variant for az3 traffic to reduce eviction pressure. Applying config patch.

```yaml
# runtime rollout snippet
modelRouting:
  region: az3
  fallbackModel: gpt-small-compat
  rollout: canary
  weight: 0.15
```

sam (infra): applied a kubelet readiness patch to node-az3-12 to stop noisy restarts; restarting kubelet is in progress (rolling).

maria (oncall): timeline: divert + model fallback + kubelet restart initiated. Monitoring 10m for stability. If error rate >1% globally or az3 doesn't stabilize, we'll escalate to full evacuation of critical shards.

natalie (cs): prepared a short customer message: "We are investigating increased latency for a subset of requests in region AZ3. Traffic has been diverted while we remediate; most customers unaffected. We'll update in 10 minutes." Want OK to post? :eyes:

maria (oncall): OK to post. Do it.

ops-bot: statuspage update queued: statuspage://incident/7632105555-draft -> posted.

ben (sre): note: KV cache hit-rate in az3 improved after fallback model applied. Eviction rate trending down.

jordan (runtime): quick rollback plan if divert causes problems: revert divert via same endpoint, revert modelRouting patch, and scale up az1 further. Reversion command below.

```bash
# revert divert
curl -X POST "https://internal-router/api/v1/divert/revert" -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_ROUTER_TOKEN" -d '{"job_id":"divert-7632105555-01"}'
```

maria (oncall): we're seeing stabilization at 8m. Global 5xx ~0.5%, az3 specific ~0.7%. Good. Keep monitoring.

sam (infra): kubelet restart finished on node-az3-12. No further restart cycles observed.

maria (oncall): leaving PD bridge but staying as primary until midnight UTC. Ben, Jordan, Sam please rotate into follow-ups and post RCA notes if things reoccur.

natalie (cs): customers notified. I'll field inbound messages and escalate if a customer reports persistent degradation.

ben (sre): creating a short incident entry for later RCA: will include metrics, divert job details, node logs, and runtime config changes.

maria (oncall): closing PD incident for now — will mark as resolved once 30m stable. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: Incident PD-88321 acknowledged and marked as resolved by maria (oncall).

incident-bot: Thread closing notes: remedial actions taken: traffic divert (30%), model fallback (gpt-small-compat), kubelet restart on node-az3-12. Follow-ups: full RCA, consider autoscaler cooldown tuning for az3 to avoid similar thrash.

maria (oncall): tldr: short-lived kvcache eviction + kubelet instability in az3 -> divert and fallback fixed within 10m. RCA scheduled.
